snippet.title: PEGTURE: Peg Solitaire Roguelike – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
PEGTURE: Peg Solitaire Roguelike is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.

This trailer showcases PEGTURE: Peg Solitaire Roguelike’s core gameplay and mechanics.

🚀 Releasing on September 9, 2026!

We are a small indie team from Turkey, currently developing PEGTURE: Peg Solitaire Roguelike. Follow the channel to support us and see more development updates.

Wishlist on Steam:https://store.steampowered.com/app/4295100/PEGTURE_Peg_Solitaire_Roguelike/


#Pegture #IndieGame #Roguelike #Deckbuilder #SteamGames #GamingTrailer #GameDev #IndieDev
